title: Hearty Canadian Lentil Lasagna
description: A hearty, flaky, weeknight Canadian dish featuring lentils, en-croute, and low-fat-friendly options.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the chopped onion and grated carrots to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tomato paste, crushed diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth to the skillet.
Stir in the rinsed and drained lentils.
Season the lentil mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
In a large baking dish, spread a thin layer of the lentil mixture on the bottom.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the lentil mixture.
Spread half of the remaining lentil mixture over the noodles.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the remaining lentil mixture.
Top the lasagna with chopped fresh parsley.
